title: ShortBoi's Craftable Uncraftables
description: Craft uncraftable recipes! Also adds new blocks and items.
body:
![ShortBoi's Craftable Uncraftables](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/773997a44b90845d4026ff6839e5ae8b26d7b325_0.webp)
Craft uncraftable items with _ShortBoi's Craftable Uncraftables!_

This mod adds a few new items and blocks, as well as adding recipes for uncraftable items without breaking the game.
